eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Orange, VA; at 10:45 AM on AUG 23, 2024 Effective until 6:45 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
A Do Not Use order for all customers of RSA's Wilderness water system remains in effect due to unknown contamination.  

Bottled water distribution is available at Locust Grove Middle School using the bus lot entrance.  A limited supply is available as of 1:00pm, 8/22/24 with more truckloads on the way.  Additional points of distribution are being considered for bulk distribution of water for persons with their own containers.  This information will be published when available.
